task: Assess this role against the candidate's recorded work preferences using only the supplied sources. Explain each preference judgment and recommend a supported next step.

sources.text: The position requires exactly two office days per week and permits three home-working days.
Annual base salary for this role is CHF 170,000–190,000.
Business travel is capped at 5% of working time.
The description does not specify a conference budget.

allowed_exceptions: I accept up to two required office days per week if annual base salary is at least CHF 160,000.

preferences.text: I require business travel of no more than 10% of working time.
I would value an annual conference budget.
